findings.summary: Body text cites TerminalShortcutService.ts:182-200 (recoverFromBackup) as reading the .bak this requirement makes atomic, but the Trace Links table omits a row for it while including the equivalent row for the other three services (CommandPresetService.ts:137-152, RecoveryOptionService.ts:192-203, WorkspaceService.ts:178-195).
findings.failure_scenario: A reader using only the Trace Links table (the SRS-MD 'source of truth' surface for code references) to audit which backup-read call sites this requirement obligates would miss TerminalShortcutService entirely, even though the body text and AC-7 both require it to hold.
findings.short_summary: TerminalShortcutService backup-read cited in body but missing from Trace Links

findings.summary: Tags field carries 'feasibility:high', a key:value token not used by any neighboring requirement (020/021 use '-') and not defined anywhere in SRS-MD-Rules-v2.5.0.md's Tags guidance ('comma-separated tags for search and classification').
findings.failure_scenario: Not a parsing hazard (Tags is free-form), but it is an ad hoc convention introduced in this one block that a tooling consumer expecting plain tags would not recognize as a Priority/Risk duplicate signal.
